Each perfect matching is a Petersen-supported permutation; the relative-permutation nontrivial cycles are in bijection with alternating cycles. All 60 states and all 1770 unordered pairs were exhaustively recomputed from scratch. The script found exactly 120 six-cycle and 60 eight-cycle edges, F6 components 54+six isolates, octagon degree multiplicities {0:24,2:30,10:6}, combined connected 60 with distance histogram (180,570,720,300) and all three claimed sphere profiles. A separate S5 relabeling calculation verified orbit sizes 6,24,30. Girth six and F6 disconnected prove the sharp cutoff; finite verification here is exhaustive because the domain is one explicitly finite graph, not an infinite extrapolation.
